segments.title: denial of intrinsic beginnings and endings

spans.tib: las la skye ba dang 'gag pa rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa
spans.eng: a deed has a beginning that exists by definition and an ending too that exists by definition
the later condition of the deed's having ended

spans.tib: de rang bzhin gyis grub par

spans.eng: the ending of the deed is that way

spans.tib: rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i tshul gyis
spans.eng: through any nature of its own
any beginning or ending of a deed

segments.note: PROVISIONAL machine alignment produced by Codex from the C05:227 spine row. GMR English is quoted verbatim. The two definition passages are kept as phrase-level recasts because the first Tibetan predicate scopes over both beginning and ending; sogs is omitted because this English quotation supplies no separate closing gesture. C16:804 is textually identical in ACIP, Wylie, and English but is not treated as independent publication evidence.
